main.description: Search vertex_vessel by name prefix (case-insensitive), MMSI exact, or IMO exact. RW-friendly: prefix uses LOWER(name) ~ '^lowercase' (LIKE 'x%' with native vector eval). ADR-2605011500.

q.description: Query string. Numeric ≥ 7 digits → MMSI/IMO exact, otherwise name prefix (min 2 chars).

results.description: Array of { mmsi, imo?, name?, callsign?, type_class, flag_iso?, last_seen_ms, last_lat?, last_lon? }.
